prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised transparent print artwork for the Dragon Bible black T-shirt, not a mockup.
Input image: edit target and identity reference. Preserve the identity of this original cream-and-antique-gold dragon curled around a flame with arched wings and three stars. Recompose it into a SQUARE apparel graphic with MUCH LARGER, bolder typography relative to the dragon. The dragon emblem occupies roughly the upper 58% of the composition; the type occupies the lower 37%, with clear air between emblem and words. Keep the dragon dignified, the same character, colors and engraving aesthetic, but use robust printable lines.
Exact text in large bold classical serif capitals: "DRAGON BIBLE" on one wide line. Below it, two substantial clearly readable centered lines: "BEFORE WE WERE DIVIDED," and "WE HAD WINGS." The motto letters must have roughly half the cap-height of the brand name, so every word remains readable at shirt viewing distance. Broaden the lettering across the full design width and remove the old tiny decorative side rules. Aim for the brand name at least 1.5 times the original relative scale and the motto twice its original relative scale. No extra text.
Production: true transparent background and negative space. Opaque warm parchment cream and antique gold ink only, flat fills, crisp smooth edges, no gradient, metallic effects, distress, colored specks, shadows or halos. All stars and text fully inside square canvas with 4% outer safe margin. Highest supported native resolution. No garment, no photo, no rectangle, no scene, no watermark.
